commodities.name: Crude Oil WTI
commodities.currencyCorrelation: Usually inversely correlated with USD strength and sensitive to CAD, NOK, and MXN.
commodities.economicImpact: Feeds transport inflation, energy earnings, fiscal revenue, and global risk sentiment.
commodities.demandDrivers: Global travel, airline fuel, chemical feedstock, heating

commodities.name: Brent Crude
commodities.currencyCorrelation: Important for GBP, EUR inflation expectations, and Gulf currency liquidity.
commodities.economicImpact: Global oil benchmark for fiscal balances, trade deficits, airlines, and petrochemical margins.
commodities.demandDrivers: European heating, Russian sanctions impact, Asia demand

commodities.name: Natural Gas (Henry Hub)
commodities.currencyCorrelation: Links to EUR industrial costs, USD LNG exports, and Gulf energy flows.
commodities.economicImpact: Moves utility costs, fertilizer input prices, and European industrial competitiveness.
commodities.demandDrivers: Power generation, heating, industrial feedstock, chemical production

commodities.name: Liquefied Natural Gas
commodities.currencyCorrelation: Sensitive to AUD, EUR, and global energy security premiums.
commodities.economicImpact: Critical for European energy independence, Asian power costs, and energy transition.
commodities.supplyRisk: Political risk in exporting nations, shipping disruptions
commodities.demandDrivers: Cold weather, European industrial production, Asia growth

commodities.name: Gold
commodities.currencyCorrelation: Often rises when real yields fall or USD weakens; important for CHF and ZAR risk views.
commodities.economicImpact: Reserve asset, inflation hedge, mining earnings driver, and safe-haven sentiment gauge.
commodities.demandDrivers: Central bank reserves, jewelry, technology, investment flows, risk-off sentiment

commodities.name: Silver
commodities.currencyCorrelation: Sensitive to USD, MXN mining exposure, and industrial growth expectations.
commodities.economicImpact: Blends precious-metal risk hedge behavior with cyclical industrial demand.
commodities.demandDrivers: Solar panel production, electronics, batteries, jewelry, industrial uses

commodities.name: Copper
commodities.currencyCorrelation: Strong read-through to AUD, CLP, CNY demand, and global manufacturing PMIs.
commodities.economicImpact: Core industrial growth signal for infrastructure, electrification, and mining equities.
commodities.supplyRisk: Mine strikes, environmental issues, geopolitical risk
commodities.demandDrivers: EV battery production, grid modernization, building construction, electrical wiring

commodities.name: Platinum
commodities.currencyCorrelation: Tied to ZAR, mining equities, and automotive production cycles.
commodities.economicImpact: Critical catalyst for auto emissions, mining economy driver for South Africa.
commodities.supplyRisk: South African supply risk, labor disputes, mine production
commodities.demandDrivers: Automotive catalysts, jewelry, electronics, dental, chemical catalysts

commodities.name: Wheat
commodities.currencyCorrelation: Important for emerging-market inflation and trade balances in food-importing economies.
commodities.economicImpact: Direct food CPI input and political risk indicator for import-dependent regions.
commodities.supplyRisk: Weather disruptions, Black Sea exports, crop diseases
commodities.demandDrivers: Bread production, animal feed, industrial uses, emerging market food security

commodities.name: Corn (Maize)
commodities.currencyCorrelation: Sensitive to USD strength and impacts BRL, MXN agricultural trade flows.
commodities.economicImpact: Major feed cost driver, biofuel policy influence, emerging market food inflation.
commodities.supplyRisk: Weather in US Corn Belt, South America droughts
commodities.demandDrivers: Ethanol production, animal feed, food products, industrial starch, emerging markets

commodities.name: Soybeans
commodities.currencyCorrelation: Strong BRL, AUD, and USD sensitivity through South American supply.
commodities.economicImpact: China trade sentiment barometer, animal feed cost driver, farming margins.
commodities.supplyRisk: South America weather, China demand, US production
commodities.demandDrivers: Animal feed, soybean oil for biodiesel, protein extraction, emerging market demand

commodities.name: Coffee
commodities.currencyCorrelation: Impacts BRL heavily, signals emerging-market consumer growth.
commodities.economicImpact: Emerging-market export revenue, consumer discretionary sentiment in importing nations.
commodities.supplyRisk: Brazil frosts, droughts, labor issues, disease
commodities.demandDrivers: Global beverage consumption, emerging market growth, café chains

commodities.name: Sugar No. 11
commodities.currencyCorrelation: Brazil BRL link, competes with ethanol for cane use.
commodities.economicImpact: Food inflation signal, energy policy link via Brazilian ethanol.
commodities.supplyRisk: Brazil weather, India production, policy changes
commodities.demandDrivers: Beverage sweetening, confectionery, biofuels, emerging market consumption

commodities.name: Lithium Carbonate
commodities.currencyCorrelation: Linked to AUD, CLP, CNY, and global EV equity sentiment.
commodities.economicImpact: Key transition-metal input for battery costs, auto margins, and energy storage capex.
commodities.supplyRisk: China's market dominance, capacity additions, EV demand uncertainty
commodities.demandDrivers: EV battery production, grid battery storage, aircraft batteries, medication

commodities.name: Uranium (U3O8)
commodities.currencyCorrelation: Links to CAD, AUD, KZT-linked supply risk, and long-duration energy themes.
commodities.economicImpact: Strategic fuel for nuclear power, grid reliability, and decarbonization policy.
commodities.demandDrivers: Nuclear power generation, grid decarbonization, energy security, net-zero commitments

commodities.name: Rare Earth Elements
commodities.currencyCorrelation: China geopolitical premium, linked to CNY, AUD mining equities.
commodities.economicImpact: Critical supply-chain risk for green energy transition and advanced manufacturing.
commodities.supplyRisk: China supply control, processing bottlenecks, environmental regulations
commodities.demandDrivers: Permanent magnets for EVs/wind, electronics, smartphones, defense applications

commodities.name: Steel (Hot Rolled Coil)
commodities.currencyCorrelation: Strong CNY, AUD link through China demand and iron ore prices.
commodities.economicImpact: Global growth indicator, construction cycle signal, manufacturing sentiment.
commodities.supplyRisk: China production shifts, capacity utilization, iron ore cost pass-through
